title: Correct MCP tool contract manifest coverage
claim: FP-MCP-353A corrected the MCP tool contract manifest and checker to include the 10 additional tools registered through src/tool-registrations/recent-tools.ts, establishing exact coverage of all 78 actual registered bridge tools while keeping the ChatGPT-safe surface at 11 tools.
summary: The MCP bridge correction in commit 43b2002 updated src/tool-registry/tool-contracts.ts and scripts/check-tool-contracts.mjs. The checker now scans src/server.ts, src/tool-groups/*.ts, and src/tool-registrations/recent-tools.ts. Verification showed 78 expected tools, 78 registered tools, 78 contracts, 11 ChatGPT-safe contracts, no duplicate registered tools, no duplicate contracts, no missing contracts, and no extra contracts. pnpm build and pnpm test passed. No runtime behavior changed.
caveats: FP-MCP-353A is a corrective manifest/checker patch required before FP-MCP-354 surface filtering.
The corrected actual static registration surface is 78 tools, not the previously recorded 68.
The 10 recent-tools registrations were conservatively classified outside chatgpt-safe.
The running MCP service may still be using old loaded code until service restart/action refresh.
The bridge branch remains ahead of origin until pushed manually.
boundaries: Did not modify MCP runtime behavior.
Did not change tool names, descriptions, input schemas, output schemas, annotations, approval literals, or handlers.
Did not clear the disable switch.

structuredRecord.nextRecommendation: Push FP-MCP-353A, then resume FP-MCP-354 with corrected counts: chatgpt-safe default 11, all 78, dev likely 76 if legacy remains 2.
